_comment: PROPOSAL ONLY — campaign-v2 draft 2026-09-22. Does NOT supersede frozen config/campaign-v1.json. Freeze a copy with code+config hashes before any claim run.
model: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B rev 12a3808a, BF16, ctx 8192, mfs 0.50, mrr 6, mtt 8192, skip-warmup (inherit v1 verbatim; tracker sglang_flags mfs 0.8 records pilot window — resolve + freeze exact launch flags before claim runs)
power: MAXN, no clock changes (tracker PROPOSED; freeze nvpmodel -q dump per cell)

sglang_flags_base.mem_fraction_static: inherit v1 frozen launch (0.50 per v1 string; confirm vs tracker 0.8 pilot note at freeze)
sglang_flags_base.max_running_requests: >=5 on interference cells so 5th arrival overlaps instead of queues (T1.1 check-2: rr=4 queues)

strand_A_nvme_direct.goal: NVMe-direct blocked replication: prove file-tier (storage) restore repeats under paired-block design
strand_A_nvme_direct.arm: nvme_direct = host flags (--enable-hierarchical-cache + --hicache-ratio, RAM backend default) + --hicache-storage-backend file + --hicache-io-backend direct + SGLANG_HICACHE_FILE_BACKEND_STORAGE_DIR on NVMe
strand_A_nvme_direct.storage_dir: /media/ssd/saisandesh/TierKV/runs/campaign-v2/hicache-file (PROPOSED; must be under /media/ssd, O_DIRECT; record df + dir listing per cell)
strand_A_nvme_direct.workload_match: paused_out_tokens 64 + 4x bg decodes x 128 out, arrival_offset_ms 500 (match v1 matrix overlap)
strand_A_nvme_direct.prefix_policy: fixed synthetic prefixes with SHA256 recorded per length (zero-reuse leading tokens, same generator seed as v1); store prefix SHA in each cell json
strand_A_nvme_direct.background: file-tier proven reference 2026-09-22: 758MB KV overflows 0.70GB host pool; restore serves cached 3456 = dev 6 + host 2042 + storage 1408, TTFT 16.41s, no crash under bg load
strand_A_nvme_direct.exclusion_carried: kernel/page_first H2D-eviction cells stay excluded (3/3 fatal); this strand runs ONLY direct backend

strand_B_file_overflow_replication.goal: replicate file-overflow spill+restore >=5 matched cells ( Quiet vs Loaded ) with fixed prefix SHAs
strand_B_file_overflow_replication.workload_match: 64-out foreground + 4x bg x 128-out overlap, arrival_offset_ms 500 (same as strand A / v1)
strand_B_file_overflow_replication.prefix_policy: fixed prefixes C/D/E + extensions, SHA256 recorded (runs/imported/file-overflow/prefix_fo_{C,D,E}.txt as reference set)
cells: fo-loaded (spill + bg-loaded restore; expect storage>0 cached split)
strand_B_file_overflow_replication.accept: storage-tier tokens > 0 on restore with TTFT recorded; crash/miss indexed not pooled

strand_C_sharegpt_expand.goal: ShareGPT sensitivity expansion (additive; never pooled with synthetic)
strand_C_sharegpt_expand.slice: ShareGPT_Vicuna_unfiltered rev 192ab218, 6011-tok prefix, slice_sha256 recorded (see runs/imported/sharegpt/SHA256SUMS)
strand_C_sharegpt_expand.current: b0+b1 x 4 arms COMPLETE-sealed-imported-verified (nvme skipped by design); direction matches synthetic on every arm
strand_C_sharegpt_expand.plan: extend to b0..b4 x 4 arms (retain/host_d2h/host_h2d_direct/recompute) + pilot nvme_direct b0..b1 at 6011 only (direct backend required); direction-vs-synthetic contrast per arm+phase+metric, same gating
strand_C_sharegpt_expand.scope_rule: superiority claims never from ShareGPT alone (analysis_sharegpt.py order-gate)

thermal_admission.policy: admit cell only if thermally settled; record clocks/temp/slope per cell (PROTOCOL system-validity)
gates_PROPOSED: MAXN fixed, no clock changes during campaign
tegrastats thermal snapshot pre/post cell (record; thresholds frozen at pilot)
cooldown wait if post-cell temp slope rising; log wait_s

failure_index.rule: failures/OOMs/crashes indexed per cell, never pooled into aggregates (analysis_main.py enforced)
failure_index.arrival_gating: matrix_pass + arrival_ok required (arrival http 200, completion_tokens==64); None metric values dropped per block with warn
failure_index.warmups: excluded from every aggregate (warm=True listed only, e.g. nvme warm-spill reference)
failure_index.nvme_rule: nvme meas 0/15 crash-documented in v1 stays listed; v2 nvme_direct cells counted separately, must_exclude-from-v1-claims preserved

seal_policy.method: find . -type f -not -name SHA256SUMS -exec sha256sum {} + sorted by path, verified with sha256sum -c (per runs/imported/SEAL.json 2026-09-21 precedent)
seal_policy.scope: per-strand dirs under runs/campaign-v2/{nvme-direct,file-overflow,sharegpt-expand} + imported read-only mirror
seal_policy.gate: mismatches==0 per dir before analysis import; analysis writes results/ only (summary.json rev bump, coverage.json, figures/)
seal_policy.stats: paired-block 95% percentile bootstrap B=10000 seed=20260921; 10% practical margin; boards reported separately, never pooled
